amendment.source: Verified existing GSE174376 human/PDX RMS source
amendment.selection: Complete TAR headers/primary GSM metadata; first accession GSM5293229 fixed before count values
amendment.analysis: All pilot barcodes; frozen86symbols/explicit H1-10 alias; raw counts and totalUMI>=500 sensitivity, no invented annotations
amendment.limits: RNA counts not protein/drug evidence; pilot not replication or route closure when further cohort work is feasible

title: SJRHB030680_R1
treatment_protocol_ch1: Nuclei were isolated from frozen tissue samples using a combination of detergent and mechanical separation in TST buffer. A detailed protocol is available on protocols.io at https://dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bhbcj2iw
extract_protocol_ch1: Tumor and xenograft samples were dissociated using an enzymatic tumor dissociation with papain. A detailed protocol is available on protocols.io at https://dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.98ah9se
10x genomics 3’ scRNA-seq gene expression kits were used to construct libraries
10x genomics 3’ scRNA-seq gene expression kits were used to construct libraries
data_processing: Single cell or nucleus RNA-seq reads from tumors or O-PDXs were aligned using the 10x Genomics Cell ranger Pipeline (v3.0.2) to the hg19 reference data v3.0.0 (for tumors) or hg19-and-mm10 v3.0.0 (for O-PDXs). In the case of single-nucleus datasets, a custom pre-mRNA reference was used to include intronic reads into expression matrices
